title: Chain-level short exact presentation of the relative Mayer--Vietoris comparison
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S form a cartesian square of schemes. Assume S,S′ affine and f quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K∈D_QCoh(O_X), K′∈D_QCoh(O_X′), and φ:L(g′)K→K′. Let U,V cover X with U,V and U∩V quasi-compact. There exist short complexes P,P′ of cochain complexes of O_S′-modules, a morphism m:P→P′, and isomorphisms of their six derived objects with the global, biproduct and overlap source and target objects of the fixed relative Mayer--Vietoris maps [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Both short complexes are short exact. The four localized differentials correspond to the fixed relative first and second maps. The localized first and third components of m correspond respectively to the specified global and overlap base-change arrows. No connecting morphism or distinguishedness is asserted.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-unbounded-mayer-vietoris), 08HZ (lemma-unbounded-relative-mayer-vietoris), and 08HY (remark-base-change); perfect.tex, Tag 0DJ9 (lemma-single-complex-base-change), induction diagram

proof.text: Use the enhanced relative mapping-cone construction to obtain a strict square and the six vertex comparisons with the fixed relative arrows.

Apply the general functorial short exact cylinder presentation to this strict square. Compose its six localization comparisons with the six geometric comparisons. Postcompose each of its four differential equations and two endpoint equations with the corresponding geometric comparison; associativity gives exactly the six required equations.

theorem relativeMV_ses_presentation
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S'] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let aX := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (P P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (m : P ⟶ P')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁ ≅ aX.left)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂ ≅ (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ aX.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).right),
      P.ShortExact ∧ P'.ShortExact ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map P.f ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ relativeMVSourceFirst f g U V K ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map P.g ≫ e₃.hom = e₂.hom ≫ relativeMVSourceSecond f g U V K ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map P'.f ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₁'.hom ≫ relativeMVTargetFirst g' f' U V K' ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map P'.g ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₂'.hom ≫ relativeMVTargetSecond g' f' U V K' ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ aX.hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ e₃'.hom = e₃.hom ≫ (a (U ⊓ V)).hom
